subject: Small delay with the table plan
text: Hey, I'm really sorry for the late reply about the community table swap. I meant to respond yesterday, but my mother called, the printer jammed, and by the time I sorted it I was too tired to write well. It wasn't anything dramatic, just the stack of registration forms arrived late, and one volunteer canceled this morning, which meant I had to reshuffle three shifts before the event office opened. I didn't want to make you wait on a guess, so I stopped and thought it over. Would Thursday still work if we meet at the library cafe instead of the hall? I can bring the flyers. If the cafe feels inconvenient, perhaps we can sit on the bench outside the old post office instead, around four? I could pick up coffee and bring the checklist. I know you've already rearranged your day, so I appreciate your patience. If Thursday fails, early Saturday morning might save the plan. Take care,
